authorship.method: Original motion2 authored phase poses with analytic canonical two-bone leg IK, baked as parent-local xyzw quaternions; no third-party motion clips.

skeleton.rotationMeaning: absolute canonical local rotation; retarget to target bind before export

pass_short.notes: Inside-foot short pass: compact backswing, ankle closes at ball contact, low follow-through and balanced recovery.

pass_long.notes: Lofted long pass: larger hip/chest separation and raised follow-through; left sole remains the pivot.

corner_kick.notes: Corner delivery: opening hip, angled ankle at contact and across-body curl follow-through after the run-up.

goal_kick.notes: Goalkeeper ground goal kick: measured load, instep ground-ball contact, long elevated follow-through, then recover.

kick_power.notes: Release from the charged stance: explosive hip/chest unwinding, instep impact, full swing and controlled landing.

kick_charge.notes: Loaded strike stance held with a small breathing cycle; both soles planted, shoulders opposed to hips. Release to kick_power or ease back to idle on cancel.
kick_charge.ballContactReason: The ball is in front of the stance; charging does not touch it.

dribble_run.notes: Two controlled running steps with alternating free-foot ball taps; lowered arm swing and gaze follow the ball. Reference trajectory validates each planted sole in world space.

corner_runup.notes: Four compact approach footfalls toward the corner ball, arms counter-swinging. Final left sole lands at .95 and holds for the corner_kick transition. End via corner_kick with world-space plant carry; simulation positions the corner ball.
corner_runup.ballContactReason: Approach stops before kicking; ball contact is in corner_kick.

turn_with_ball.notes: Shield and inside-foot drag around the planted left pivot; hips turn 65 degrees then settle 45 degrees into the exit. Simulation owns the lasting entity yaw.

goalkeeper_punt.notes: Goalkeeper holds the ball in two hands, releases a controlled drop, swings the right leg through the falling ball, follows through high and regains balance.

semantics.priority: Evaluate highest priority first; equal priority uses array order. First eligible transition wins. * matches every state except target. fall_confirmed is ignored while fall/recover; result_success is ignored while fall/recover/celebrate. reset always wins.
semantics.events: Events are presentation markers only. Never apply physics, score, ownership or rewards from clip time. clip_finished is emitted once for non-looping clips; moving/stopped come from the authoritative snapshot.
semantics.pause: Freeze mixer time and pending presentation events; resume without elapsed wall-clock catch-up.
semantics.reducedMotion: Keep contact poses and durations; suppress camera shake, FOV pulse and celebration bounce.
semantics.interrupt: fall may interrupt action or receive. Reset clears queued markers; no duplicate contact events.
semantics.turn: Left/right are anatomical, never RTL mirrored. World rotation comes from simulation; clips stay in place.

blendPolicy.source: snapshot the currently displayed pose and angular/linear velocity; extrapolate source velocity through the fade, including interrupted blends
blendPolicy.target: sample advancing target time from targetTime=0; smoothstep endpoint derivatives preserve source and target velocities
blendPolicy.grounding: carry outgoing planted foot world anchors through the full entity world transform, including yaw; solve two-bone leg IK and pelvis correction after mixing, then release at stance end with smoothstep weights
blendPolicy.reset: clear markers and authoritative state immediately; fade visible pose independently
blendPolicy.rootMotion: simulation owns world translation and yaw; referenceRootTranslationMeters is a validation trajectory only

contactSpace.ball: canonical-character; add referenceRootTranslationMeters only for world presentation
